title: Grampa Jacob
textBlocks:
Grampa Jacob
BLESSES his grandsons
Hello Bravehearts, in today’s Bible story 
you will meet Joseph’s sons, 
Manasseh and Ephraim

Grampa Jacob blessed his grandsons, 
Manasseh and Ephraim
Manasseh and Ephraim were Joseph’s sons
Manasseh was the eldest of the 2 brothers.
Which normally means that he would get the BIGGER BLESSING
BUT
Jacob crossed is arms and gave the BIGGER BLESSING
to the younger son, Ephraim

When Joseph saw that, he tried to tell his father, but Jacob said that he knew what he was doing
So the YOUNGER son got the BIGGER blessing

Dear Lord Jesus
Thank you for all my blessings,
for my family and friends
Thank you for looking after me and keeping me safe
Amen
